notes.title: 4th November 2022 Update
notes.notes:
This is the most expansive update so far!

New worlds to explore!
- Explore new areas from the start! Player feedback has told us that you want to explore more from the start so we have given the player access to additional levels from the Hubspace, soon as you load into the game. Simply travel to these spaces via the star map in the Princess' Cruiser Ship.

Worlds that no longer require progression to access:
- Numba, a robot war factory built into the frozen cliffside, enter and activate the H.O.R.D.E. gamemode where you will fight against waves of robot enemies and gain better resources and loot as you progress. 

- Seeder Ship Dungeon, A seeder ship is a dormant colony ship carrying biological DNA held in stasis. Something has gone wrong and the robots built to maintain the ship has gone rogue and you must stop them! 

- NEW! Crag-7: A desolate asteroid a drift in space. long ago a Bullzorb seeder ship set out to colonise nearby Planets but crashed into a rogue asteroid. Explore the dangerous terrain and see what lurks in the sprawling caves. This is the first version of this level and will see new quests and hidden secrets to discover in future updates. 

Weapon Redux
Slugnoid weapons have been remade and brought to a higher level of detail and better functionality. New sounds have also been added to most weapons. 
- A-Salt Rifle can be upgraded to full-auto and plays better with more accuracy. 
- A-Salt Musket is a high damage weapon that can become a long range marksman rifle
- Shakket is a pump action shotgun that now has a bigger kick!
- NEW! Phagous is a heavy machine gun built to rain fire down on your enemies.
- Orosoko is a bolt action rifle with the most extensive upgrade system to date.
- Brine has the biggest change, this is now a high capacity SMG that does more than just tickle
- Slikks Shooter is a dinky revolver that becomes a battle worthy carbine. 
There has also been various changes to other weapons to offer a better gameplay experience, and many more weapon changes to come.

Game Improvements
- Added Fog and foliage to levels to add better visuals and create an immersive atmosphere
- UI and functionality improvements in the Star Map for a better user experience
- Heat damage applies to enemies in the pits on the war factory level
- Overhauled the navigation system in the game so escort missions and enemies will now move around more naturally.
- The early version of player inventory is set up and can now pick up lettuce and lettuce milk to consume them for health. (only available in the hubspace for now so grab your lunch before you venture out.)
- Added more detailed assets to levels to improve the visual look of the game.  
- Changed the name of the "Crazy Warships" mission to "Data Seed"
- New Enemy, Zombie Bullzorb. These are a new enemy type in the Crag-7 level and are corrupted by the Space Shrooms.
- Added a shiny new jetpack to play around with, this is in early stages of development but have fun.
- Jetpacks will spawn with the drop pods during the "Rock and a Hard Place" mission.
- Altered the portal entrance in the architect ruins in the asteroid open world.

Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue with deleting save data
- Solved the issue with the Queen quest icon not appearing until you find her in the hubspace
- added a quest marker above the Princess during "Queens Gambit" Mission
- Fixed several issues with the Segway, rotation speed and orientation is now fixed
- Fixed weapon projectiles when firing full auto not following camera orientation. 
- Fixed issues with weapon upgrades not applying correctly
- Players will now die when falling into the space on all levels.
- Correct light levels are now on the open world asteroid level

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
First Content Update

Features:
Humongous Fungus Side Mission
Venture to the deeper parts of the Asteroid Shard Cluster and destroy the fungus plaguing the area

Seeder Ship Dungeon Mission
Take the fight to the robot threat and can save the Bullzorbs if you choose to, either way you get to shoot more stuff! 

H.O.R.D.E. Mode 
Enter the Heavy. Ordinance. Robot. Development. Emulation. and gain new rewards including all new weapons, crypto and more resources to upgrade your arsenal.

Consumables
The player can now pick up Lettuce and Lettuce Milk and equip them to their consumables slot to heal during gameplay. (Prototype for future inventory expansion) 

New UI
Star Map, Main Menu, Loadout and other menus are now improved. 

Sluggard Redux
The sluggard character class now has a sleek and slimy new look!

Map Changes
Odious Opus Hubspace has more clutter
Asteroid open world has more fungus growing throughout
Robot Spaceship interiors are now more detailed 
T1NY-1 asteroid level to access the Nullverse Void had various improvements

Bug Fixes:
Queen Pathing during escorts improved. 
Player now dies when falling out of levels
Star Map UI is more consistent and can access areas as the player unlocks them
Can access all options in the Main Menu
Missions are more consistent when playing in various orders
Physical objects are now more optimised and can be pushed around more easily
Additional sounds added to enhance gameplay
Monster Truck Segway gameplay improvements
Various quality of life changes 
Various performance improvements

notes.title: Update 4th March 2022
notes.notes:

Bugs and Fixes

- improved flying enemy AI 
- Font Changes to UI and Colour changes
- Pause menu has a cross to escape the menu more quickly on all tabs
- Various Tutorial updates
- Fixed a bug where swapping between legs and vehicles spawns another player character
- Improvements to the Star Map 
- Fixed issue when during 'Queen's Gambit' Mission you would spawn inside the Princess ship
- added a button to open the princess ship and stops the player from being locked inside

notes.notes:

- Monster Segway vehicle added to the hub space.

Bugs and Fixes
- Fixed issue with saving game files
- Fixed issue where sometimes the queen would stop during escort missions
- Fixed issue with enemy death explosions not causing damage to the player
- Changes to Slug torso slime trail FX

notes.title: Update notes for 14th Feb
notes.notes:
New start to Fralife!

The game opens in the Slugnoid hub space, this area will be the main base for the game. 
- A basic tour of the ship 
- Shops for weapons and resources
- New beginning quest dialog for the Queen
- Firing range to test your aim
- Original Tutorial plays after speaking to the Queen

B1G1: Asteroid level Open world 
- Many notable design changes
- New art pass adding in Space Shrooms and a new visual look to the level
- Lighting is now darker
- The mission 'System Crash' Collect food now has a counter and progresses correctly
- Swapping between mission now works as intended
- Added 'The living Architecture' side mission
- Now shows completed missions in the Mission Log
- Fast travel after 'Rock and a Hard Place' is working better 
- Added more resource breakables so collecting food should be easier

Bug Fixes
- Melee update melee has had numerous improvements but will still be worked on for future updates
- Ranged combat has more precise aiming with the Slugger class
- Fixed issue with enemy projectiles have been update and will deal correct damage
- Fixed issue when sometimes Blaaztor shots would stay after shooting
- Fixed issue when in dialog with the Hologram at the end of 'Welcome Aboard' mission, The player should nolonger get stuck in Dialog
- Fixed navigation during escort missions with the queen 
- Explosive Barrels now work correctly
